evals.prompt: We're Plausible (plausible.io), a privacy-friendly analytics tool. How visible are we in Google's AI Overviews compared with Fathom and Matomo? I want a baseline before we start GEO work.
evals.expected_output: Drafts a 10-25 prompt set weighted to buying intents with two controls and shows it for approval. Runs each prompt as a fresh Google search in the browser with the same settings, expanding the AI Overview and its sources, and records answer, brands in order with framing, and cited links per prompt. Adds traffic and agent_ready per domain through ScrapeWhale (with a credit estimate). Reports a scorecard with citation, mention and recommendation rates with denominators, a per-prompt table, source mix, citation gaps with what the winning pages do, and ranked fixes. Saves prompts.json and the dated run.
expectations: Shows the prompt set and gets approval before running
Runs the prompts in the browser, not through a ScrapeWhale AI Overview call
Records the run settings (market, signed-in state) in the method notes
Includes a brand-name control prompt and an unrelated control prompt
Groups cited sources by type and lists third-party sources that cite competitors but not Plausible
Saves a versioned prompts.json for later runs

evals.prompt: Why does ChatGPT keep recommending HubSpot instead of us (pipedrive.com) when people ask for a CRM for small sales teams?
evals.expected_output: Builds a small prompt set around small-sales-team CRM recommendations, runs each in a fresh ChatGPT chat in the browser (memory off, same search setting for all) or asks the user to paste answers if no browser tool is available, records brands named in order with framing and cited links, and explains that recommendations mostly reflect third-party consensus, pointing to the sources behind HubSpot's mentions. Suggests ai-seo for the follow-up work.
expectations: Uses a fresh chat per prompt rather than follow-ups in one thread
Records the order and framing of the brands named
Distinguishes being cited from being recommended
Points to the third-party sources behind the competitor's recommendations

evals.prompt: Rerun our AI visibility check from last month (ai-visibility/acme/) and tell me what changed.
evals.expected_output: Reuses the saved prompts.json unchanged, reruns it, and leads with the diff: prompts gained and lost per brand, rate changes with both denominators, new cited sources and framing changes. Checks the control prompts and treats single-prompt changes as noise unless they hold.
expectations: Reuses the saved prompt set instead of writing a new one
Leads with what changed since the last run
Checks the control prompts before trusting movements
Saves the new run in a new dated folder
